name: DeleteCertificate
label: Delete AWS ACM Certificate
description: Deletes an AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) certificate using AWS credentials resolved from environment or IAM role.

fields.name: AWSServiceVaultId
fields.label: Credential to connect with
fields.description: Select the AWS credential to use for authentication (AWSServiceVaultId).

fields.name: CertificateArn
fields.label: Certificate ARN
fields.description: The ARN of the ACM certificate to delete (e.g., arn:aws:acm:us-east-1:123456789012:certificate/...).

fields.name: BucketName
fields.label: Bucket Name
fields.description: S3 bucket name where the certificate was imported (only required for imported certificates).

fields.name: CertificateKey
fields.label: Certificate Key
fields.description: Key of the certificate in S3 (only required for imported certificates).

fields.name: Response
fields.label: API Response
fields.description: JSON result containing success or error details
